offline_storage.title: Offline-first local storage
offline_storage.purpose: Persist user-owned data on device with explicit schema/versioning and export/clear behavior.
acceptance: Choose one storage engine based on data shape; do not add multiple engines without justification.
Version and migrate persisted schemas; preserve existing user data.
Include empty/loading/error states and safe clear/export behavior where appropriate.
Test persistence across app restarts and malformed/old data recovery.

local_notifications.title: Local notifications
local_notifications.purpose: Schedule on-device reminders with user controls and timezone-aware behavior.
acceptance: Ask notification permission contextually and respect denial without blocking the app.
Use stable notification IDs; cancel or reschedule obsolete reminders.
Handle Android notification channel and exact-alarm requirements only when needed.
Test permission denied, app restart, timezone/daylight changes, and duplicate scheduling.

onboarding.title: First-run onboarding
onboarding.purpose: Explain the app value in a short, skippable first-run flow.
acceptance: Allow skip/back and never trap users in onboarding.
Persist completion only after a valid finish or explicit skip.
Do not request sensitive permissions before explaining their value.
Add widget tests for first launch, completed launch, skip, and back navigation.

settings_and_preferences.title: Settings and preferences
settings_and_preferences.purpose: Provide a predictable place for theme, reminders, privacy, data management and app information.
acceptance: Settings reflect actual app state and persist across restarts when appropriate.
Use accessible labels, confirmation for destructive actions, and a clear reset path.
Do not display settings for integrations that are not configured.
Test persistence, reset behavior, and permission-state changes.

forms_and_validation.title: Forms and validation
forms_and_validation.purpose: Build accessible forms with inline validation, safe submission state and keyboard handling.
acceptance: Use the existing state-management choice; do not introduce a second state-management framework.
Validate on submit and then provide helpful inline feedback.
Prevent duplicate submissions and preserve safe input when recoverable errors occur.
Test invalid, valid, keyboard, loading, server-error, and accessibility cases.

api_client.title: HTTP API client
api_client.purpose: Centralize request timeouts, JSON parsing, typed failures and safe retry policy.
acceptance: Use the existing HTTP client if one already exists; otherwise choose one and document why.
Set connection/receive timeouts and map errors to user-safe messages.
Retry only safe/idempotent requests by default; never blindly retry writes.
Keep secrets out of the app bundle and logs; test timeout, offline, non-2xx and malformed JSON.

firebase_optional.title: Optional Firebase integration
firebase_optional.purpose: Scaffold only the explicitly selected Firebase services.
acceptance: Confirm platform targets and services before adding dependencies.
Never invent google-services.json, GoogleService-Info.plist, API keys or project IDs.
Use least-privilege security rules and exclude PII/secrets from telemetry.
Mark each service NOT CONFIGURED until real project setup and runtime tests are evidenced.

admob_optional.title: Optional AdMob monetization
admob_optional.purpose: Add ads only when monetization is explicitly selected and consent requirements are addressed.
acceptance: Use Google test ad units during development; do not hardcode production IDs into shared templates.
Place ads without obstructing core actions or accidental clicks.
Implement applicable consent/privacy flows and age/audience requirements.
Test load failure, no-fill, offline behavior, lifecycle and ad-free core usability.
